title: 📸 The funeral procession of the late Iraj Khajeh Amiri is underway today. The farewell ceremony for the legendary vocalist Hossein (Iraj) Khajeh Amiri, widely revered as the "Champion of Persian Vocals," is being held in front of Vahdat Hall this Friday, August 14, 2026, and is being attended by several state officials and prominent figures from the arts community.
